caseNameFull: NOLAN v. RHODES, GOVERNOR OF OHIO, Et Al.
attorneys: Kenneth G. Weinberg and Stewart R. Jaffy for appellant., William B. Saxbe, Attorney General of Ohio, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
